common.tagline: Turn documents into controlled, auditable business processes.
common.independentProject: Independent portfolio project — not affiliated with any third party

landing.heroSubtitle: Turn documents into controlled, auditable business processes.
landing.heroBody: A document operations platform combining a governed repository, workflow automation, AI-assisted processing and a complete audit trail.

documentIntelligence.title: Document intelligence
documentIntelligence.body: Classification, metadata extraction and questions over content, with confidence indicators and human validation.

workflowAutomation.title: Workflow automation
workflowAutomation.body: Visual process design, execution with deadlines, escalation and reassignment, and a full timeline per instance.

secureSearch.title: Secure search
secureSearch.body: Metadata and full-text search with server-side paging, always limited to what the user is allowed to see.

aiProcessing.title: AI-assisted processing
aiProcessing.body: An AI abstraction layer with a deterministic demo provider and optional connection to real models.

auditCompliance.title: Audit & compliance
auditCompliance.body: Immutable record of access and decisions, retention policies, sensitivity classification and legal hold.

integrations.title: Enterprise integrations
integrations.body: Adapters for e-mail, ERP, CRM, electronic signature and webhooks, with synchronisation logs.

landing.demoBody: The demo uses the fictional organisation Asteria Group. All data is invented.
landing.footerNote: Independent technical demonstration. Not a commercial product and not associated with any vendor.
